description: Unique identifier of one browsing session; one row per session. Primary key.
Anonymised token for the visitor who owned the session. Contains no name, email, phone or IP. 490 distinct tokens; 10 appear in two sessions.
privacy_note: Pseudonymous - treat as personal data under DPDP Act 2023

description: Page type recorded for the session record. Ordered by journey stage: Home, Category, Product, Cart, Checkout, Confirmation.
allowed_values_or_range: Home | Category | Product | Cart | Checkout | Confirmation

description: Identifier of the product associated with the session. 307 distinct products.
Time spent on the recorded page, in seconds. Mean 150 s, median 147.5 s; distribution is close to uniform.
1 if the session added at least one item to the cart, else 0. 175 of 500 sessions (35.0%).
1 if the session ended in a purchase, else 0. 106 of 500 sessions (21.2%). 74 of these have add_to_cart = 0 (see flag_purchase_without_cart).
Device class used in the session: Desktop 171, Tablet 171, Mobile 158.
Data-quality flag: purchased = 1 but add_to_cart = 0 (logically inconsistent). 74 rows.
Data-quality flag: page_type = Confirmation but purchased = 0. 60 rows.
Data-quality flag: purchased = 1 while page_type is Home, Category or Product. 56 rows.
1 if any of the three flags above is 1. 151 rows (30.2%).
Engagement level from time_on_page_s: Low (<=60 s), Medium (61-180 s), High (>180 s).

sample_values: Browse only | Purchase (no cart) | Browse only
description: Combined outcome: Browse only, Cart abandoned, Cart + Purchase, Purchase (no cart).
allowed_values_or_range: Browse only | Cart abandoned | Cart + Purchase | Purchase (no cart)

description: Salted SHA-256 hash (first 12 hex chars) of user_id, for joins without exposing the raw token. Demo salt - rotate and keep secret in production.
